# Organise My House

> > Chrissy's comprehensive home organization platform offering decluttering courses, management systems, and free resources to help people transform their homes.

Organise My House is a UK-based home organization resource founded by professional organizer Chrissy. The site combines paid digital products (The Declutter Equation course and The Home File management binder) with extensive free resources including printables, challenges, and blog content to support users at every stage of their organizing journey.

## Key Topics

- The Declutter Equation
- The Home File
- Home Organization
- Decluttering
- Free Printables
- 5 Day Declutter Challenge
- Home Management Systems
- Professional Organizer

- Digital Products
- Life Admin
- Home Systems
- Decluttering Courses

## Core Products & Courses

- [The Declutter Equation - Home Decluttering Course That Works](https://organisemyhouse.com/the-declutter-equation-decluttering-course): Main decluttering course product page with step-by-step home transformation program
- [The Home File - Ultimate Home Management Binder System](https://organisemyhouse.com/home-file-home-management-binder): Home File product page: fillable/printable binder with 8 management sections
- [Homepage | OrganiseMyHouse Shop](https://shop.organisemyhouse.com): Product shop showcasing The Declutter Equation, Home File, and planning tools

## Free Resources & Challenges

- [FREE 5 Day Declutter Challenge - Start Now](https://organisemyhouse.com/5-day-declutter-challenge): Free 5-day decluttering challenge with 10-minute daily tasks for beginners
- [Free Printables Library - 100+ Templates You Can Use Now!](https://organisemyhouse.com/free-printables-library-access): Access to 100+ free printable templates for home and life organization
- [Resources](https://organisemyhouse.com/resources): Directory of free printables, quizzes, challenges, and affiliate resource links

## Blog & Educational Content

- [The Organise My House Blog - All Articles To Get Organised](https://organisemyhouse.com/the-blog): Blog hub with articles on home organization, decluttering, and life admin
